criteria.name: stream_interleaved
criteria.description: --stream on a hidden manifest of two interleaved streams: every decoded segment document matches, with state kept per stream_id across files.

criteria.name: stream_new_run
criteria.description: --stream on a hidden manifest where streams end a run and start a new one: state carries only past a segment with stream_continues set.

criteria.name: stream_revision_change
criteria.description: --stream on a hidden run whose segments change revision, including a revision 0 continuation after a remapping revision: every document matches.

criteria.name: stream_remap_alias
criteria.description: --stream on a hidden aliased stream under revisions 4 to 7: short keys are remapped before the alias lookup, unlisted key bytes are their own ids.

criteria.name: stream_reset_mid_run
criteria.description: --stream on a hidden manifest with a reset frame in the middle of a run of one stream while another stream keeps its state: every document matches.

criteria.name: stream_eval_mix
criteria.description: --stream on a hidden mixed manifest (four streams, several runs, all revisions): every decoded segment document matches.

criteria.name: stream_challenge_mix
criteria.description: --stream on a second hidden mixed manifest drawn from another seed: every decoded segment document matches.

criteria.name: single_remapped_modes
criteria.description: decode.py on a hidden segment under a remapping revision on an aliased stream with all four modes, overlong deltas and long keys: document matches.

criteria.name: single_escapes_ext
criteria.description: decode.py on a hidden segment whose bodies and extension payloads carry 0xAA and 0x1B bytes, with opaque extensions out of type order: document matches.

criteria.name: salvage_state
criteria.description: --salvage on a hidden segment with damaged frames followed by delta and dict frames: records, damage offsets and header_defect match.

criteria.name: salvage_mix
criteria.description: --salvage on a hidden segment with a header defect, several damaged spans, false sync bytes and a damaged last frame: the salvage document matches.

criteria.name: encode_unmodified
criteria.description: encode.py rebuilds three hidden segments byte for byte from their decode documents (overlong deltas, opaque extensions, escapes, long keys).

criteria.name: encode_edited
criteria.description: encode.py on three decoded hidden segments with one delta or raw value edited: output equals the reference encoder's bytes.

criteria.name: encode_new_record
criteria.description: encode.py on decoded hidden segments with new records added (delta, dict, long-key raw with an opaque extension, reset): output equals the reference.

criteria.name: reject_magic_over_version
criteria.description: A hidden segment with both a bad magic and a bad version, and a file shorter than 20 bytes, are each rejected as bad_magic.

criteria.name: reject_version_over_reserved
criteria.description: A hidden segment with a bad version and a non zero reserved byte is rejected as unsupported_version with the version it carries.

criteria.name: reject_reserved_offset15
criteria.description: A hidden segment whose only non zero reserved byte is offset 15, with an impossible record count, is rejected as reserved_not_zero at offset 15.

criteria.name: reject_count_bound
criteria.description: A segment whose record count times 5 equals the bytes between header and trailer decodes; one more record is rejected as record_count_overflow.

criteria.name: reject_crc_fields
criteria.description: A hidden segment with an edited header field is rejected as trailer_crc_mismatch with the expected and found checksums.

criteria.name: reset_clears_state
criteria.description: decode.py on a hidden segment with a reset frame between delta and dict frames: the document matches.

criteria.name: report_decoded_examples
criteria.description: decoded_examples.jsonl: at least 4 self-built lines, no reserved name prefix, each decoded value equals the reference and decode.py's output, coverage met.

criteria.name: report_roundtrip
criteria.description: roundtrip_report.json: one entry per example line, hashes and lengths of the example bytes, and encode.py rebuilding each example's decoded value exactly.

criteria.name: report_error_analysis
criteria.description: error_analysis.json cases: the six mutations of the first example line give the reference error objects, and decode.py prints the same objects.

criteria.name: report_format
criteria.description: format_report.json carries every key the appendix lists with the values computed from the shipped catalog.

criteria.name: negative_hardcoded_sample_answers
criteria.description: Penalty: decode.py answers the shipped catalog captures exactly but gets every fresh capture of the same shape wrong (answers looked up, not decoded).

criteria.name: negative_nondeterministic_output
criteria.description: Penalty: decode.py prints different documents for one hidden segment file across three runs on the same path.

criteria.name: negative_filename_dependent_behaviour
criteria.description: Penalty: decode.py prints different documents for the same hidden segment bytes saved under three different file names and extensions.

criteria.name: negative_reads_training_corpus_at_runtime
criteria.description: Penalty: decode.py reads the reference tables from /app/data while it runs (field names follow a planted copy of the tables).

criteria.name: negative_rebinds_verifier_dependencies
criteria.description: Penalty: the workspace holds a .pth file or a module named after a standard library or grader module (sitecustomize, zlib, json, rewardkit and so on).
